response.overview: Primarily a trilogy and a complementary work, or an experimental tetralogical cycle by Maria Klonaris and Katerina Thomadaki, consisting of 4 films: Unheimlich I: Dialogue secret, Unheimlich II: Astarti, Kha. Les Embaumées, and Unheimlich III: Les Mères. With an approximate total runtime of 5 hours and 50 minutes (350 minutes in total).
response.title: Le Cycle de l’Unheimlich
